metadata.neutral_citation: CHIOK WAH MING v. KOWLOON MOTOR BUS CO (1933) LTD AND ANOTHER [1980] HKCFI 24
metadata.case_name: CHIOK WAH MING v. KOWLOON MOTOR BUS CO (1933) LTD AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: the Plaintiff sustained a fracture of the left parietal bone
source: the Plaintiff sustained a fracture of the left parietal bone, and that as late as the 5th July 1978 he appeared to suffer from retrograde amnesia, that is amnesia for events before the accident.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of parietal bone of skull

injuries.description: brain contusion/lesion in the left parieto-occipital area
source: It is the Plaintiff's case that as a result of these injuries, (a) he sustained brain damage in the left occipito-parietal region, which is permanent and which has led to the development of a rare symptom known as prosopagnosia-an inability to recognise faces,

"the location of this abnormality coincides well with the hypothetical site of lesion, i.e. left parieto-occipital area in a right-handed person, that would give rise to a visual agnosis as in his case."
He accepts that there was a fracture of the parietal bone, and that there was a brain lesion, albeit very small 1 - 2 mm's across, but is of the view that this has healed with some scarring

manifestations.description: prosopagnosia - an inability to recognise faces
retrograde amnesia (amnesia for events before the accident)
virtually unemployable / inability to hold down previous employment

treatments_future: psychiatric treatment including medications (antidepressant and other symptomatic chemotherapy) and supportive psychotherapy twice a week for the first month then once a week for a further five months (as assessed by the Court)

losses.description: general damages for pain, suffering and loss of amenity assessed by the Court at $30,000
special damage - loss of wages to date assessed by the Court (net) at $42,500
future loss of earnings assessed by the Court at $10,000 (for six months from receipt of award)
cost of psychiatric treatment to be undergone (assessed by Court at $5,600)
